piṇḍaka.cp: masc. a lump; a lump of food.

C: piṇḍaka：[m．] a lump； a lump of food．
P: Piṇḍaka，[fr．piṇḍa] （alms）--food A．IV，185 （SS piṇḍapāta）； in phrase na piṇḍakena kilamati not go short of food Vin．III，15，87； IV，23，in ukka-piṇḍaka meaning a cluster of msects or vermin Vin．I，211=239 （v．l．piṇḍuka）．（Page 458）
R:
piṇḍaka：ပိဏ္ဍ-က （ပ）
ဆွမ်း။ ကက္ကုကမျဉ်း။
DOP: piṇḍaka m. , 1. [ ts ] a lump or ball of food, esp. given as alms; food; Vin III 15, 15 (bhikkhū ca lābhaṃ lacchanti ahaṃ ca ~ena na kilamissāmī ti); M I 379, 17 (dīgharattaṃ kho te gahapati nigaṇṭhānaṃ opānabhūtaṃ kulaṃ yena nesaṃ upagatānaṃ ~aṃ dātabbaṃ maññeyyāsī ti); 380, 25 (sace te bhante ~ena attho etth’ eva tiṭṭha etth’ eva te āharissantī ti); Ud 59, 6 (kacci pi appakilamathena addhānaṃ āgato na ca ~ena kilanto sī ti); Thī 2 (vippamuttena cittena anaṇā bhuñja ~aṃ; Thī-a 8, 25 foll.: raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjeyyāsi … ~an ti desanāsīsam eva, cattāro pi paccaye ti attho); Spk III 24, 4 (ekena kapiṭṭhaphalamattena ~ena amhākaṃ attho ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee piṇḍikena); — ifc see agga- ( sv agga 1 ), guḷa- ( sv guḷa 2 ), piṭṭha- ( sv piṃsati ); — 2. [ S. lex. id. ] an incense; Abh 302 (turukkho tu ca ~o).
